item.title: UN experts urge probe into Epstein files, warn crimes against humanity possible
item.description: Experts noted that the scale and global nature of abuses against women and girls could amount to crimes against humanity.

item.title: Nigeria announces arrival of 100 US soldiers following Trump's claims of Christian 'persecution'
item.description: Abuja says it requested US troops plus equipment to help train soldiers of the West African country.

item.title: Lebanon says next Hezbollah disarmament phase to take four months
item.description: Second stage of the plan depends on available capabilities, Israeli attacks, and hindrances on the ground, according to Lebanese Information Minister.

item.title: Trump says he will be involved indirectly in Iran talks
item.description: US President noted that Iran sought tough negotiations but learned consequences of such hardened stance last summer when the US bombed Iranian nuclear sites.

item.title: Trump says US in talks with Cuba, calls it a 'failed state'
item.description: US president said they would see how it all turned out, adding that for now there was an ‘embargo’, ‘no oil’, and ‘no money’.

item.title: Oil holds steady as markets eye crucial US–Iran talks
item.description: Crude markets held near recent highs as traders weighed Middle East tensions and upcoming US–Iran nuclear talks, with OPEC+ signalling a possible output hike ahead of summer demand.

item.title: Deadly stabbing attack in Australia's Sydney
item.description: The attack occurred on Merrylands Road, a busy commercial strip in western Sydney.

item.title: Land concessions in focus at high-stakes Russia-Ukraine peace talks in Geneva
item.description: US-mediated talks in Geneva follow two rounds in Abu Dhabi, with land remaining the key sticking point, and hopes are low for any major breakthrough.

item.title: Guatemala ends state of emergency as gang crackdown cuts crime
item.description: President Bernardo Arevalo replaces a month-long emergency decree with a “state of prevention” after 11 police officers were killed in gang-linked violence.

item.title: Russia reports repelling 150 Ukrainian drones overnight ahead of Geneva negotiations
item.description: Russian officials say one child was wounded in Crimea after what they call one of the longest drone attacks in recent times, ahead of a new round of diplomatic talks to end to war.
